summary: Full backend + frontend validation of the REDESIGN_AND_I18N feature (Part A polish + Part B i18n). ALL review-request checks PASS. BACKEND: (1) `pytest tests/test_i18n.py -q` -> 10/10 pass. (2) `pytest tests/ -q` -> 82/82 pass in 103s (matches spec's stated baseline). (3) NEW /app/backend/tests/test_e2e_i18n.py -> 2/2 pass in 86s hitting the public preview URL: english analyze (no language field) completes with language=='en' and verdict.decision in {BUY,SELL,HOLD}; hindi analyze (language='hi') completes with (a) language=='hi' persisted on the doc, (b) top-level JSON KEYS unchanged/English (verdict, debate, timeframes, language present), (c) verdict.* keys unchanged/English (decision, confidence, target_price, stop_loss, summary, key_risks, time_horizon), (d) verdict.decision still a raw English enum (BUY/SELL/HOLD — asserted membership), (e) each timeframes.{short,medium,long}_term.decision still English enum, and (f) free-text values (verdict.summary + debate.bull/bear/fundamentals + per-horizon thesis) contain Devanagari characters (regex [\u0900-\u097F]) proving the language_directive was honored. FRONTEND (390x844): (1) On first load bottom tab labels are English ('ANALYZE'/'HISTORY'/'AGENTS'). (2) Agents tab -> testID 'language-picker' scrolled into view, all 4 rows visible (language-option-en/hi/es/zh). (3) Tap language-option-hi -> tab labels instantly re-render to Hindi: index='विश्लेषण', history='इतिहास', agents='एजेंट्स'. (4) Analyze screen post-switch: search placeholder='टिकर खोजें — AAPL, BTC-USD…', compare button='तुलना करें', screen contains 127 Devanagari chars across headers/section labels/CTA. (5) Persistence: `page.reload()` -> tab-index still 'विश्लेषण', confirming settings:language storage round-trip works. (6) VERDICT ENUM PROTECTION UI: opened a completed analysis (AAPL) with Hindi active -> verdict-block text = 'PORTFOLIO MANAGER VERDICT HOLD विश्वास स्तर 78%' — the enum 'HOLD' stays in raw English while the CONFIDENCE label is translated to Hindi ('विश्वास स्तर'). (7) 52-WEEK RANGE BAR: QuoteCard on the analysis screen renders the thin range bar with '235.03' on the left, '344.57' on the right, and a marker positioned near the right (live price 332.27 is close to the 52w high — position looks correct visually). QuoteCard stats row is translated too: '52 सप्ताह न्यूनतम' / '52 सप्ताह अधिकतम' / 'एक्सचेंज'. (8) CHIP FADE: 4 category chips (trending/stocks/crypto/commodities) render on the Analyze tab; a right-edge LinearGradient (rgba(255,255,255,0) -> surface, width 28px) is coded in /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/index.tsx:344-350 inside chipScrollWrap — code verified. Non-regression: no red screen; only console noise is the pre-existing 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated' RN-web warning and the innocuous iframe sandbox notice from the preview shell.
critical_code_review_comments: server.language_directive() correctly returns '' for lang=='en' AND for unsupported/None inputs — verified by test_english_is_a_true_noop / test_unsupported_language_falls_back_to_noop; English behavior is byte-identical (verified by the fact that all 63 pre-existing english backend tests still pass unchanged, plus the E2E english run returns valid verdict with English enum).

The 9 lang_directive call sites in run_analysis (analyst_tasks + BULL/BEAR x2 rounds + RM + Trader + Risk + PM + Debate + Timeframes) all use string concatenation (sysmsg + lang_directive) so PM_SYS/etc are NEVER mutated — verified by test_system_prompt_constants_never_mutated.

language field is defensively re-validated inside run_analysis (language if language in SUPPORTED_LANGUAGES else 'en'), which is a good belt-and-suspenders check because the POST /analyze route also normalizes it.

AnalyzeRequest.language default 'en' + POST /analyze fallback for unsupported values means an unknown language code silently degrades to English (rather than 4xx). If a client sent language='fr' they'd get English output with language='en' on the doc — probably the right behavior for a preview feature, but worth confirming with the product spec.

LanguagePicker relies on local `useState<LanguageCode>(getCurrentLanguage())` initialized once on mount — the source of truth is i18next + AsyncStorage via setLanguage(). Live re-render of tab labels and screen strings is achieved through useTranslation() subscribing to i18n.on('languageChanged'). Verified live re-render works. Non-blocking note: if LanguagePicker is unmounted and remounted, `current` re-reads correctly from getCurrentLanguage(), so no stale state across tab switches.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_e2e_i18n.py (new — 2 end-to-end LLM tests against the public preview URL: english=no-op, hindi=Devanagari free-text with English keys+enums)
seed_data_creation: Two live analyses created against the public preview URL via the e2e tests (one english AAPL, one hindi AAPL). Both reached status=completed. No other DB writes.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Feature is fully verified. If retesting: (a) Hindi/es/zh analyze runs take ~40-90s on this pod — the e2e file polls up to 180s with 3s intervals. (b) The Devanagari assertion is intentionally lenient (ANY of summary/debate arguments/per-horizon thesis containing script chars — because on a given run the LLM may emit an empty thesis but still translate the summary). (c) Tab labels and analyze-screen strings live-update because useTranslation() subscribes to i18next; no page reload is needed after tapping a language-option-* row. (d) After tapping into a specific /analysis/{id} the bottom tab bar is HIDDEN by the stack navigator, so any test that plans to tap a tab AFTER opening an analysis detail must navigate back first (router.back or a done button). This tripped one step in the ui probe but isn't a real bug. (e) The chip fade LinearGradient renders as a positioned <div> on web — it has no testID; verify by inspecting element style (position:absolute, right:0, width:28). (f) Storage key for persistence is 'settings:language' (see /app/frontend/src/i18n/index.ts:20). (g) The verdict-block shows an English enum ('BUY'/'SELL'/'HOLD') by design via `decision.toUpperCase()` on line 19 of VerdictBadge.tsx — do NOT flag this as an untranslated string; per spec the enum values are contract-protected.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs found. English is byte-identical (language_directive('en')==''), Hindi/es/zh append a directive that instructs free-text translation while explicitly protecting JSON keys and BUY/SELL/HOLD enums, and the LLM honored the instruction on live runs. All Part A polish (52-week range bar + chip fade gradient) renders. All Part B i18n behaviors (picker, live re-render, persistence, VerdictBadge enum protection, translated QuoteCard 52w labels) verified end-to-end.
